name: expense-tracker-microservices
description: Gestionnaire de dépenses pédagogique en architecture microservices NestJS et Angular.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix api-gateway && npm ci --prefix users-service && npm ci --prefix expenses-service && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api-gateway && npm run build --prefix users-service && npm run build --prefix expenses-service && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix api-gateway -- --runInBand && npm test --prefix users-service -- --runInBand && npm test --prefix expenses-service -- --runInBand
